owner_request: 2026-10-08 Notion 任务跟踪器 #40 交易系统生成: 1 BB 密集 2 大阳/大阴吞没突破密集区 3 六条均线密集 4 放量 5 止损在均线下面, 盈亏比 1:3 或 1:5; 「扫一下吧 几个周期都试试」; 六条均线 = SMA/EMA 20/60/120; 图中指标为 SPIKE V13.1
question: Does the owner's five-condition squeeze breakout, entered at the next open with the stop below the six MAs and a fixed 3R or 5R target, earn more than matched random entries with the same stop distance and targets, after 0.2% cost, in both periods and on which timeframes?
prior_evidence: SPIKE V9 already combines a six-MA dense rope, V7 BB compression, a volume ratio and a solid breakout candle; its two-year replay was gross positive but net negative in the later year after 0.2% cost (-2089R) with matched excess p 0.19 (exp-spike-v9-full-backtest-20260915-v1, exp-spike-v9-later-year-attribution-20260917-v1). New here: stop below the six MAs, fixed 3R/5R targets, an engulfing breakout of the dense zone, decision at the breakout close.
data: frozen Binance USD-M 5m series (data/research/spike_v128_entry_clock_long_20260923/series), complete-bucket resampling
universe: per month, top 100 alts by previous-month median daily quote volume (stables excluded) plus BTCUSDT and ETHUSDT; an event counts only if its symbol is in that month's universe

rule.bb: SPIKE V7/V9 compression: BB SMA200 +/- 2 population stdev, width = (upper - lower) / basis; a bar is compressed when its width <= the linear 10th percentile of the previous 500 widths; the signal needs 3 consecutive compressed bars inside the 12 bars before it
rule.dense: SPIKE dense rope: six close MAs SMA/EMA 20/60/120; width = (max MA - min MA) / ATR14; mean width over the 12 bars before the signal <= 3.0 and >= 2 pairwise MA order flips over those 12 bars
rule.candle: long: close > open, body >= 1.0 ATR14 of the previous bar, body / range >= 0.55, body engulfs the previous body (close >= max(prev open, prev close) and open <= min(prev open, prev close)); short mirrored
rule.breakout: long: close > max(six MAs) and close > highest high of the 12 bars before; short mirrored
rule.volume: volume / median volume of the 20 bars before >= 1.5 (SPIKE rv)

atr: Wilder ATR14 as ewm(alpha=1/14, adjust=False, min_periods=14) on true range; EMAs ewm(span, adjust=False); warmup differs from Pine seeding only in the first bars, which are excluded by the 700-bar readiness requirement
stop: long: min(six MAs at the signal bar) - 0.2 ATR14; short: max(six MAs) + 0.2 ATR14; skip when the entry is not beyond the stop
exit_path: bar high/low from the entry bar; a gap through the stop or target fills at the open; stop first when both are touched in one bar; exit at the close after max_hold_bars; a missing bar before the exit drops the trade

controls.pool: same symbol, timeframe and calendar month, ready bars, not the event bar, ATR/price within 0.5-2x the event's
controls.stop: same stop distance in ATR units as the event (event risk / event ATR x control ATR)
controls.targets: same R targets, cap and cost
controls.revision: 2026-10-08: the first run (source 1106e6b825) matched controls in ATR units without a volatility band; 23 of 61421 primary events drew frozen-price bars (ATR near 0, delisting months of AGIX/FTM/MKR/DEGO/BNX) whose cost/risk exploded and made mean excess unusable. Event results were unaffected; that output is kept in results_v1_unbanded_controls.

primary: per timeframe, side and target: mean net R and excess over matched controls in each period; a timeframe qualifies only if both periods are positive after cost and excess is positive with month-block sign-flip p < 0.05 in at least one
descriptive: share of trades that never trade below the entry (owner remark), split by outcome
net R by stop size bucket in percent of price
data_quality: an event or control bar needs at most 10% zero-range (high == low) or zero-volume bars among the 50 bars before it; added 2026-10-08 after the candidate gallery showed a 1H ASTERUSDT 'breakout' out of days of a frozen 0.600 price (pre-listing / suspension), which trivially passes the BB and dense-MA tests
